catalysts.headline: Marvell agreed to acquire Lumentum (LITE) in an all-stock deal valuing Lumentum at roughly $115B enterprise value (~$102.5B equity value per Reuters-derived reporting); exchange ratio of 4.500 Marvell shares per Lumentum share; Marvell shareholders to own ~67% of the combined company on a fully diluted basis, Lumentum holders ~33%; Lumentum CEO Michael Hurlston and two other Lumentum directors to join Marvell's board, Matt Murphy remains Chairman/CEO; combined company expects >$1B in annual run-rate cost synergies from the AI-driven shift from copper to optical connectivity; deal expected to close H1 2028 pending stockholder and regulatory approvals.
catalysts.impact: Reported by Bloomberg as the largest M&A deal of 2026 by equity value and the largest-ever in global tech excluding the SpaceX/xAI merger

catalysts.headline: Marvell shares fell 13.2% on reports it was closing in on a Lumentum buyout, ahead of the official announcement
